Thompson Siegel & Walmsley Has Raised Holding in Target (TGT) as Valuation Rose; Salesforce.Com (CRM) Holder Quantres Asset Management LTD Decreased Holding
May 25, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Quantres Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Salesforce.Com Inc (CRM) by 34.56% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quantres Asset Management Ltd sold 4,700 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.89% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 8,900 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $910,000, down from 13,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Quantres Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Salesforce.Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $95.03B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.64% or $0.83 during the last trading session, reaching $127.91. About 3.40M shares traded. salesforce.com, inc. (NYSE:CRM) has risen 39.46% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 27.91% the S&P500.
Thompson Siegel & Walmsley Llc increased its stake in Target Corp (TGT) by 6.32% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Thompson Siegel & Walmsley Llc bought 15,796 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.77% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 265,607 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $17.33 million, up from 249,811 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Thompson Siegel & Walmsley Llc who had been investing in Target Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $37.96B market cap company. The stock increased 0.41% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $71.23. About 5.44M shares traded. Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) has risen 28.46% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.91% the S&P500.
Thompson Siegel & Walmsley Llc, which manages about $7.40 billion and $8.41B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Motorcar Parts Of America In (NASDAQ:MPAA) by 60,162 shares to 288,765 shares, valued at $7.22 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Cigna Corp (NYSE:CI) by 1,577 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 80,312 shares, and cut its stake in Cms Energy Corp (NYSE:CMS).
